settings.text: About the courses, access and refunds. Anything else, write to us.

settings.question: Which editing app do I need?
settings.answer: Any of the common ones. Lessons show the idea first and the clicks second, and each lesson has notes for the three most used apps.

settings.question: I have never edited before. Where do I start?
settings.answer: The 7 Day Starter. It assumes nothing and ends with a finished one minute video.

settings.question: How long do I have access?
settings.answer: For as long as the school is open. Watch at your own pace and come back to any lesson.

settings.question: Do I get the footage?
settings.answer: Yes. Every lesson comes with the raw clips, music and project files you see on screen.

settings.question: How do the feedback calls work?
settings.answer: Once a month you send a cut of up to three minutes. On the call I go through a few of them on screen, with notes you can rewatch.

settings.question: What if it is not for me?
settings.answer: Write within 30 days and you get your money back. Replace this with your own refund terms.

settings.question: Can I buy one course and upgrade later?
settings.answer: Yes. Write to us and what you paid for single courses comes off the price of The Whole Edit.

settings.question: Do I need a fast computer?
settings.answer: No. The project files are light, and every lesson notes a lower resolution proxy if your computer struggles.

settings.question: Can I use the footage in my own work?
settings.answer: The clips are for practice. Your edits are yours to share as course work. Write your own licence terms here.

settings.text:
One short lesson a day for a week. By Sunday you have cut a one minute video from the clips we send you, with music and titles.

  • Seven lessons, about 15 minutes each
  • Raw clips, music and a title template
  • Works with any editing app
